classification.difficultyReason: Complete a supplied cosine graph using its stated even symmetry.

content.prompt:
$y=\cos\theta$ is an even function as $\cos(-\theta)=\cos\theta$.

Complete the graph for the domain $-360^{\circ}\le\theta\le360^{\circ}$.

spec.description: Cosine graph scaffold with the negative-angle half blank. Grid extends from −450° to 450° and −4/3 to 4/3, with explicit steps of 45° horizontally and 1/3 vertically. Origin O is omitted under the graph convention.
spec.mathematics: Supplied y=cos(theta) for 0°≤theta≤360°. Required completion is its reflection in the vertical axis.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the nonnegative-angle curve is supplied.

answer.short: Reflect the supplied curve in the vertical axis, through $(-360^{\circ},1)$, $(-270^{\circ},0)$, $(-180^{\circ},-1)$, $(-90^{\circ},0)$ and $(0^{\circ},1)$.
answer.worked: Since $\cos(-\theta)=\cos\theta$, points at opposite angles have equal heights. Reflect the supplied curve in the vertical axis to complete the negative-angle half.

spec.description: Complete cosine curve on the same coordinate scaffold, including the reflected negative-angle portion.
spec.mathematics: y=cos(theta), −360°≤theta≤360°; even symmetry about the vertical axis.
